audit.notes: Extremely reusable. Open with a quieter clip (cafe, chilling at home, or laptop work) paired with the doubt hook, then cut through 7-8 varied everyday lifestyle b-roll clips (walking in Central Park, bouldering, grabbing food with friends, subway ride, Brooklyn night shots) matching the rhythmic reassuring text lines.
audit.summary: A fast-cut lifestyle montage contrasting an opening feeling of stagnation with affirming reminders of personal effort and resilience over upbeat music.
